safe_git_rollback: Do not amend or rewrite the frozen FINAL_SHA.
If main has not been normalized, leave Integration unchanged and stop publication.
If main has been normalized, retain the archived pre-v2.12 main ref and use an explicit fast-forward-compatible ref update only after ancestry verification.
Use the verified git bundle to reconstruct refs; never run git reset --hard or git clean against the ordinary root.
runtime_rollback: Use scripts/runtime_control.py status before any stop action.
Stop only controller-owned instances whose PID, creation identity and worktree provenance match state.
Do not terminate unknown processes on 8000 or 5173.

database_rollback.strategy: ACL changes are additive, minimal and idempotent. If revocation is required, first capture the live ACL and revoke only the exact added privileges under database-owner supervision.

protected_assets: ordinary-root tracked and untracked user assets
